competences.description: Becomes enraged whenever an enemy gains a turn. Attacks all enemies 2 times. Greatly increases the damage proportionate to the number of times the Beast becomes enraged, and the rage effect will reset after the attack.

Attacks the enemies in the frontline 2 times with a sharp thorn. The damage increases substantially as the target's Defense decreases. This attack will target the backline if there are no enemies left in the frontline.
Attacks all enemies 3 times with a giant roar and creates the Distorted Shield. The HP of the shield will increase every time the Light Distortion is used.
Removes all beneficial effects on all enemies and attacks them 6 times with light breath to inflict damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken.
